campaign_discoveries.finding: Early prose repeatedly uses 'considered me' or similar abstract cognition where an owned physical task or information boundary can carry the beat more vividly.
Antonius is most distinct when he continues, pauses, or redirects practical work to express judgment rather than receiving generic reaction narration.
Jorren's teaching authority is physical and local: contact, timing, fatigue, road attention, and repeated attempts beat abstract speeches.
Alden is distinct from Greg when he commits to the immediate physical/operational problem, absorbs correction without needing deference, and acts before building a large systems explanation.
